Hi everyone!

I'm writing a PCIe accelerator driver in Rust that needs to map a coherent DMA allocation (Coherent<[Block]>) to userspace to implement a zero-copy mechanism.

Currently, Coherent has no mmap support, and dma_mmap_coherent / dma_mmap_attrs isn't exposed in kernel::dma.

Is there appetite for adding userspace mapping support to the DMA abstractions, and how would maintainers prefer it structured (e.g., a method on Coherent, a helper taking VmaNew, or something else)?

Thanks!
